base.validation: All839 active transformer names/shapes match the full meta model across three shard headers; two obsolete patch_embedding Conv3d tensors are explicitly excluded, matching the current author core. All source tensors are BF16. Full contents and full-scale training were not tested.

adaptations: Native platform data reader, statistics, optimizer execution, success-step state and checkpoint interfaces; no LeRobot runtime
Shared Wan2.2 transformer30 layers,24 heads of128,48 video channels and30 named action slots; actual depth and geometry inherit local transformer config
Local-only Wan VAE and UMT5 assets; frozen/eval modules outside optimizer and model checkpoint; cache frozen text inputs on writer rank for training and validation tasks and empty negative prompt
Generic atomic frozen feature stores with checksums and bounded CPU LRU; prepared features are bundled, while VAE/tokenizer and uncached text encoder remain external local assets
Wan Unicode/HTML/whitespace prompt cleanup; max512 tokens; masked text embeddings set to zero
Preserve ordered cameras, with width concatenation or explicit head/left/right T layout; bilinear resizing128x128 and RGB[-1,1] before causal VAE
Recorded named command coordinates normalized before30D placement; no dimensional inference of joint, pose or gripper semantics; reset action input/output projections for new robots by default

Training input actions are QUANTILES, unlike pinned LeRobot's IDENTITY training processor; recorded adaptation preserves outliers, explicit lingbot normalization clips targets[-1.5,1.5], denominator epsilon1e-6

Horizon means future commands: H=frame_chunk_size*action_per_frame; source first inference chunk includes initial frame in frame_chunk_size, native first chunk allocates one extra condition frame so every chunk emits H commands
Training cameras cover offsets0..H at action_per_frame/4 stride; one normalized physical-zero action group precedes future commands; complete windows trim H rows from episode ends
Native bootstrap_condition=physical_zero aligns inference with normalized training bootstrap; normalized_zero selects author's original inference conditioning convention

Original timestep sampling, random block/window visibility, noisy video conditioning and separate flow losses retained; masks passed explicitly through non-reentrant checkpointing, no class-global mutable mask
GPU Flex and CPU/reference SDPA share visibility predicates; inference automatically uses unmasked cached SDPA without manually editing config; cache follows active autocast dtype
Offline chunks independently reset and use current images only; online select_action retains actual per-tick camera feedback and predicted executed command history

Official trainer initializes FP32 weights and shards with BF16 forward/FP32 reduction; native preset uses FP32 trainable storage and BF16 AMP, retaining FP32 optimizer states; frozen assets retain BF16
Input dtype follows actual parameter storage and platform autocast instead of forcing BF16; explicit FP32 is an additional debug/reference path; global TF32 remains trainer-owned
Remote chunk execution, RTC, LoRA and dictionary-valued predicted-frame actions are not integrated
